description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Search canonical companies by name (full-text, best 200 matches), optionally filtered by HQ country. Without q: most active first (large countries continue A–Z after two pages; each answer says its `order` and `max_page`). Returns id, slug, name, kind, domain, HQ, industry, size band and editions in the last five years.

q.description: Full-text phrase matched on the company name and domain.

name: search_companies
title: Search companies
